passages.quote:
Employers must comply with the law to help prevent illegal working in the UK. This guide explains how to avoid unlawful racial discrimination when carrying out right to work checks. It covers:

your responsibility as an employer

how to check an employee’s documents

how employees can make a complaint if they feel they have been discriminated against
